textbookBox.concept: A 4-gon is a parallelogram if its opposite sides are equal, or if its opposite angles are equal.

beats.en: A 4-gon is a parallelogram if its opposite sides are equal, or if its opposite angles are equal.
beats.speakEn: A 4-gon is a parallelogram if its opposite sides are equal, or if its opposite angles are equal.

beats.en: It is also a parallelogram if its diagonals bisect each other, or if one pair of opposite sides is equal and parallel.
